description: Fix evidence-backed endpoint underuse across both agent platforms. Keep native command execution and ownership rules intact; make deterministic/indexed Hub calls the normal route when applicable and semantic calls explicitly conditional.

acceptance_criteria: Generated MCP schemas and agent instructions use one profile capability/action source and never advertise disabled actions.
High-profile defaults enable intended profile-tier capabilities; lower profiles omit actions below their minimum tier.
Static and installed skill/prompt surfaces contain no stale fixed action lists that contradict the active schema.
Every enabled public MCP tool/action family has a concrete trigger; active-profile filters suppress unavailable actions.
local_ai_task is recommended for semantic review, reasoning, exploration, and evidence compression when action, backend, and quality gates pass.
Exact repository search, facts, tests, builds, and deterministic checks retain authoritative repo/native paths.
Runtime permission, quality, backend, and task-context checks remain authoritative.
Static review confirms Codex and Antigravity outputs align.
Typed host contract records host/version/surface/session ownership, events, commands, permissions, mode, identity, evidence references, and verification state.
Only Hub-managed sessions with verified identity and permissions qualify for future host actions; unknown state fails closed.
Shadow is default and metadata-only; it never sends host messages, changes turns, stops/forces continuation, approves actions, starts delegation, or stores prompts/transcripts/source.
Host observations distinguish proposed, simulated, executed, and verified; permission checks remain unknown unless observed.
Codex App Server and Antigravity CLI stream-json have separate stage gates and honest support states.
Hook handling no longer injects planner advice or stores full prompts by default.
Analysis/status live in docs/FINAL_COMPLETION_PLAN.md without duplicate plan or direct plan-store edits.
OpenCode integration is removed from master and preserved on a dedicated branch for future client-agnostic redesign; preservation is not runtime acceptance.
task_endpoint_routing.blocker: Codex 0.167.0-alpha.3.2 App Server initialize/thread/start/thread/started is freshly verified in an isolated temporary CODEX_HOME; focused host adapter and hook suite passes (51 passed, 2 skipped). Production Hub caller/interactive lifecycle, turn and approval events, reconnect/loss handling, and provider-backed pre-inference monetary cap remain not_verified. Antigravity CLI is absent from the current shell; local version and hook delivery remain not_verified. Official hooks alone do not prove Hub ownership; payload contains lastUserInput/transcript path. Headless stream-json requires prompt/inference; tool-free launch, process ownership, permissions, cleanup and cost cap remain not_verified. Sidecar agentapi availability/permissions remain not_verified.
task_endpoint_routing.description: Extend existing Codex and Antigravity endpoint routing work with a staged, evidence-backed native host integration. Shadow remains metadata-only and cannot change host sessions. Audit findings and stage gates live in docs/FINAL_COMPLETION_PLAN.md; implement only source-supported safe stages.
task_endpoint_routing.next_action: Design and implement only a Hub-owned Codex App Server shadow lifecycle that can be exercised without turn/start or inference, including process ownership, cancellation, reconnect/loss handling, and metadata-only event persistence. Keep turns, approvals, Antigravity hooks/headless CLI, and sidecar unsupported until host ownership, permissions, and explicit budget gates are proven.
